ammonia.reason: No proteolysis or deamination in 1-day fresh cheese, no NH3 accumulation.

animal_barnyard.reason: Pasteurized cow milk and fresh washed curd, no p-cresol/indole/skatole.

bitter.reason: Minimal proteolysis to hydrophobic peptides in unaged rennet curd.

blue_moldy.reason: No Penicillium roqueforti, no C7-C11 methyl ketones.

browning.reason: Residual lactose plus protein gives moderate Maillard when melted, limited by high moisture.

buttery.reason: Trace diacetyl and acetoin from Streptococcus thermophilus citrate metabolism, low due to no aging.

cheesy_sweaty.reason: Minimal lipolysis to butanoic/hexanoic acids in fresh 1-day curd.

creaminess.reason: 53.78% moisture with 20.41% fat in stretched paracasein gives soft creamy mouthfeel.

crumbliness.reason: Demineralized stretched paracasein network is fibrous-cohesive, not fracture-crumbly.

firmness.reason: High moisture aligned pasta-filata casein gives pliable-elastic body, not hard.

floral_honey.reason: Trace milk-fat delta-decalactone/dodecalactone present but un-concentrated without aging.

fruity.reason: Trace propyl butanoate and ethyl esters from esterification, very young cheese.

goaty.reason: Cow milk only, no caprine C6-C10 branched fatty acids.

malty_nutty.reason: No aged Strecker aldehydes or propionibacteria activity in fresh cheese.

melt.reason: pH 5.25 demineralized calcium-paracasein plus high moisture flows readily on heating.

oil_off.reason: Moderate 20.41% fat with intact stretched network limits free oil on melting.

sour_vinegar.reason: Lactic acid from thermophilic starter at pH 5.25 plus only 1.86 mg/100g acetic acid.

stretch.reason: pH 5.2-5.3 aligned pasta-filata fibers from hot-water kneading form long strings.

sulfur_cooked.reason: Hot-water kneading denatures whey protein releasing trace H2S but volatiles flash off.

sweet.reason: Residual lactose and mild lactate with low salt gives milky-sweet perception.

umami.reason: Very low free glutamate and peptides from minimal proteolysis.
